propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py rebuilds identical clean-source wheel and sdist artifacts three times per test run, resulting in 35.93s total duration when only one prerequisite build should occur per session

A session-scoped per-worker immutable wheel/sdist fixture can replace per-test builds while preserving distinct real assertions for wheel-from-sdist boundary, sdist content, empty-env failure, and env-unset rebuild-from-sdist

Shared fixture consumers must receive only read-only artifact paths; mutating operations like extraction and env-unset rebuild must occur in function-scoped temporary copies to prevent shared state mutation

Deterministic build-call counting via subprocess seam demonstrates exactly one successful prerequisite build per worker/session after repair, verified by independent held-out oracle and mutation testing of duplicate-build and missing-COMMIT defects
